item.title: Dwarf Fortress 20th Anniversary Show
item.description: Hey Urists! August 8th marks the 20th anniversary of classic Dwarf Fortress and we've put together an exciting show to celebrate the occasion. Join Tarn and Zach as they play the first ever build of the game from 2006 and reminisce about the olden days. It’s been a while since they’ve played the build and it’s very unstable so who knows what will happen? We're also excited to reveal the new Myth & Magic update key art AND a brand new song from Dabu and Simon, which is also called Myth & Magic. There’s also going to be special guest appearances throughout the show from other game devs, community members and maybe even a reality tv star or two… {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34693670/4cdf3862c71ef8eec119d9903f442f4e9eaf028e.png Then, Tarn and Zach will host the first ever, Beyond Quality Awards, honoring those who have made an impact on Dwarf Fortress in the last 20 years. You don’t want to miss it! The show starts on August 5th at 11am PT/ 2pm ET/ 7pm BT on the Kitfox Twitch channel: https://www.tw...
